metric_definitions.phenotype_diversity: distinct output vectors on 64 fixed training cases; lower bound on D625 phenotype diversity
metric_definitions.compile_seconds: cached program collection; construction compilation included in variation_seconds
metric_definitions.Q: exp(mean(log(capped tree cost) - log(capped native A8 cost))); fixed eight cells, 24 build blocks, two paired repeats; failures at two caps
metric_definitions.savings: mean(actual tree effort - actual A8 effort); failures spend actual cap; evaluations and worker seconds separately
metric_definitions.repayment: mean(actual native acquisition effort) / mean(actual tree effort - actual A8 effort); unbounded when savings admit zero or negative values
metric_definitions.primitive_case_work: sum(compiled token count over evaluated individuals) times 64 training cases; execution-length proxy, excludes exact checks and internal primitive costs
